escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, the native layout of a horizontal feed and link ad, a dark film studio at night). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the LEFT 44% of the frame, from the top edge to the bottom edge, is one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte plaster studio wall with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no haze glow, no bokeh, no practical lights, no projected shapes, no screen and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives in the RIGHT 54% of the frame, between 14% and 84% of the frame height. The LOWEST 16% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a long work table right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: a Latin American creative director in her mid thirties, dark curly shoulder-length hair, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands in the RIGHT half of the frame, centered at about 70% of the width, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 21% of the frame height, the table edge cutting her at the waist; her head is almost frontal and she looks straight into the lens with a knowing, amused half-smile. Her LEFT arm is fully visible from shoulder to hand: she has just pressed a strip of matte black gaffer tape over the logo corner of a screen beside her, at chest height on the left, and her fingertips still rest on the tape. Her other arm hangs relaxed. And yet the brand is everywhere: a single hard, low, vivid orange (#FF6500) spotlight from the far left, at waist height, shines through a hand-cut stencil of the brand's signature shape, one single bold diagonal brushstroke with ragged dry-brush ends and visible bristle streaks, and PROJECTS that brushstroke as a large, crisp-edged slash of orange light across the wall behind her and across her hoodie and cheek, between 18% and 80% of the frame height. The projected brushstroke is the brightest element and the only key light on her; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair. Thin haze shows the beam only between the stencil and the wall, below 14% of the frame height. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/2, nothing foreshortened, she does not lean toward the lens. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. The projected shape is ONLY that diagonal brushstroke: no circle, no dot, no ring, no sphere, no orbit and no round shape anywhere in the frame. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand anywhere. HORIZONTAL LIMIT (essential, checked): every person, creature, light trail, projected shape, screen and prop sits entirely to the RIGHT of the vertical line at 56% of the frame width; the LEFT half of the frame shows only the dark calm surface, with nothing in it. The orange brushstroke is small and lands only on the right side of the wall, next to her.
